content:
The National Weather Service had over 4 million people looking at a Weather Prediction Center forecast posted on X on Monday.

It mostly had to do with the shape of the graphic — which tracked the chances of excessive rainfall.

The comments ran the gamut, from the most obvious: "That's a penis."

To the suggestive: "The NWS really just left the midwest wide open huh."

To the punny: "That is one massive doppler."

Hopefully there'll never be a drought.
